'''Scott McCelland''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 3rd at [[February 2001 Paxtonia tournament]] on 17 February 2001 with [[My Kind Of Scum / Fearless And Inventive|My Kind Of Scum ('not scum but uses Myo as the rep')]], according to Drew Scott's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1738">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-17-paxtonia-plaza-pa-2-17-01d1738/ paxtonia-plaza-pa-2-17-01], DeckTech (drew "drew man1" scott, 17 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-17-paxtonia-plaza-pa-2-17-01d1738/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
